text: To remove the pillion seat, insert the key in the pillion seat key slot and turn it clockwise. Slide the pillion seat forward to remove it. Then slide the rider seat backward to remove it. To refit the rider seat, slide it forward and make sure it is aligned with the frame. Place the pillion seat and slide it backward. Make sure the pillion seat is aligned with the frame, then press the seat to lock it with the key in position.
